# A fitness trainer that actually connects with you: and talks back.
Your first XR workout that truly feels personal.

Fun moves, modes, themes and exercises that make training together.. actually fun!

[media]

Strength, cardio, boxing, recovery, posture, focus, it all comes together in sessions that just feel natural.
You’re not following a script. You’re training with someone.

An exceptional level of realism, in every detail of your trainer.
[media]

Your trainer adapts to you, not the other way around.

Some days you want encouragement.
Other days you want to be pushed.

Supportive or strict. Calm or intense. Polite or brutally honest.
You decide how your trainer shows up, and how direct they are with you.

[media]

Everything stays fresh. Nothing starts to feel repetitive.
Train Together is packed with content, and it keeps growing.

Structured programs, quick sessions, and themed packs like K-Pop, Combat, Wellness, Farm Fit, Rock Gods, Tropical Beach, Superheroes, and so much more. 100+ original songs. Beautiful environments.

Always something new to come back to.
[media]

So when your motivation dips, the experience doesn’t.

Train in VR, or bring your trainer into your own room with Mixed Reality.

You don’t need perfect discipline.
You need something that makes it easier, more fun, to show up.

Show up. Move. Train together. Leave feeling better than you came in.

**This is the all-new Train Together**

**Try it for free right now.**


_

*For support, community, roadmap and more: please visit www.verseus-games.com*
